build.description: Build all workspaces in dependency order

dev.description: Run development tasks in watch mode

format:check.description: Check formatting. Inputs name every file prettier reads outside the package: the root config re-exports packages/config/prettier, and .editorconfig feeds prettier's defaults.

lint.description: Lint workspace source. Typed rules load the shared tsconfig presets through projectService, so they are inputs too (issue #308).

typecheck.description: Type-check workspace source (source paths; no prior build required). The ^typecheck edge is load-bearing: tsconfig.base.json paths resolve @repo/* to sibling source, so without it a dependency's type change left every dependent's typecheck on a stale cache hit (issue #308). The shared tsconfig presets are inputs for the same reason.

test.description: Run workspace tests. The ^build dependency is load-bearing, not caution: only apps/api, apps/mobile, packages/auth, and packages/mobile-ui alias @repo/* to source in their vitest config. Every other workspace resolves siblings through package exports, so its tests need built dist output — verified by wiping all dist and watching @repo/email#test fail. Adding source aliases everywhere would let this dependency go.
